title: Nutritional powder mix, protein, light, NFS

content.title: About
content.content: Nutritional powder mix, protein, light, NFS (5497) is a high‑quality blend of plant‑based proteins enriched with vitamins and minerals. The product is designed to support muscle recovery, boost energy, and conveniently supplement the diet. The powder dissolves easily in water, milk, or plant‑based drinks without clumping and has a light flavor.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The blend contains pea, rice, and hemp proteins, providing a complete amino acid profile.
Enzyme‑probiotic complexes are included to enhance nutrient absorption.
The product is free from gluten, lactose, and artificial sweeteners.
A light formula is specially developed for athletes monitoring calorie intake.
Packaging is made from recyclable material to reduce environmental impact.

items.title: Supports muscle growth
items.content: A rich protein composition promotes muscle‑fiber synthesis after workouts.

items.title: Improves recovery
items.content: B‑vitamins and magnesium help accelerate the body’s restorative processes.

items.title: Boosts immunity
items.content: Added vitamin C and zinc enhance the immune system’s defenses.

items.title: Reduces fatigue
items.content: Electrolytes (potassium, sodium) maintain fluid balance and lessen feelings of tiredness.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Probiotics and dietary fiber promote a healthy gut microbiome.

items.title: Allergy to plant proteins
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to pea or soy components.

items.title: Excessive protein intake
items.content: Very high protein consumption can strain the kidneys, especially in people with pre‑existing conditions.

items.title: Interaction with medications
items.content: High magnesium levels may affect the efficacy of certain drugs, such as antibiotics.

items.title: Additive sensitivity
items.content: The product contains no artificial sweeteners, but those with specific sensitivities should use caution.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Mix one scoop (≈30 g) of powder with 250 ml of water, milk, or a plant‑based beverage. For extra flavor and texture, add fruit, berries, or nuts. Consumption is recommended immediately after training or as a nutritious snack between meals.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the powder in a cool, dry place, tightly sealed. Keep moisture and direct sunlight away. For long‑term storage (over 6 months), it is advisable to keep it in the refrigerator.
